6. Integrations & APIs: High-performance API development, legacy database modernizations, webhook sync.

## Flagship Products
### Faultline (Status: Live)
- One-liner: Faultline finds where an organisation's documented knowledge contradicts itself, ranks each conflict by what sits downstream of it, and repairs it.
- Live Demo: https://faultline-production-f69d.up.railway.app/conflicts/conflict-0b1fd48ed309
- GitHub: https://github.com/rajeshr20/Faultline
- Stack: FalkorDB (raw Cypher), Python 3.12, FastAPI, React, Cytoscape.js, Groq, Gemini.
- Key Property: Collapses 57,291 combinatorial claim pairs down to 1,666 candidates using graph topology, eliminating O(n²) LLM costs.

### Quiet (Status: In progress)
- One-liner: Cafes, libraries, parks and coworking spaces near you, scored live by the people who were just there.
- Event: RevenueCat Shipaton 2026
- GitHub: https://github.com/rajeshr20/Quiet-App
- Stack: Android (Kotlin 2.0, Jetpack Compose Material 3), Supabase PostgreSQL 17 + PostGIS, Edge Functions, RevenueCat.
- Key Property: Live Quiet Score (0-100) computed exclusively in Postgres SQL function `quiet_score()`.
